complete_examples.text: Besides, an integrating solution by matrix augment method and iterative algorithm is proposed to improve the computational efficiency and accuracy.
This model employs a novel iterative algorithm to describe and compute the static deformation of the track induced by the AFZ.
In the present model, the additional deformation induced by the AFZ in the ballastless track system is harvested by using an enhanced iterative algorithm based on the Newton-Raphson method.
